title: Profiler Result Schema
description: Schema for validating rslab profiling results and receipts. NOTE: As of this release, no profiling/flamegraph tooling exists in /Users/sac/praxis (verified by exploration). This schema is prepared for future use and is not populated.

builder.description: Identifier of the builder script or ticket that generated this receipt.

experiment_id.description: The unique identifier of the experiment.

command.description: The profiler command that was executed.

raw_output_path.description: Relative path to the raw command output file.

raw_output_hash.description: BLAKE3 hash (b3sum) of the raw output file.

praxis_commit.description: Git commit hash of the praxis repository at runtime.

command_log_path.description: Relative path to the command execution log.

command_log_hash.description: BLAKE3 hash of the command execution log.

files.description: Array of files receipted during this profiling run.

toolchain.description: Metadata regarding the toolchain and environment.

evidence.description: Booleans mirroring the verif-receipt.json evidence shape, tracking empirical readiness.
